records.title: Bakery opening hours
records.text: The bakery opens at 7am on weekdays and 8am on weekends. It closes at 6pm every day.

records.title: Logo colors decided
records.text: We chose forest green and cream for the logo. The round shape stays.

records.title: Flyer print order
records.text: Print 500 flyers on A5 matte paper. The printer is Kawase Print and delivery takes three days.

records.title: Supplier for flour
records.text: Flour comes from Hokuto Mills. Orders go in every Monday morning.

records.title: Holiday closing
records.text: The shop is closed from December 31 to January 3 for the new year holiday.

records.title: Price change for bread
records.text: The basic loaf goes from 320 yen to 350 yen starting next month because butter costs went up.

records.title: New staff training
records.text: New part-time staff do two shifts with a senior baker before working alone. The checklist is in the shared folder.

records.title: Website photo shoot
records.text: The photographer comes on Thursday. Bring the seasonal cakes and the croissants for the photos.

records.title: Oven repair
records.text: The second oven was repaired by Sanko Service. The thermostat was replaced and the warranty is one year.

records.title: Social post schedule
records.text: Post on Instagram on Tuesday and Friday at noon. Use the hashtag for the seasonal menu.
